name: com.streethawk.library.push.PushNotificationBroadcastReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk sends this receiver push messages, app-status updates, and notification-response events. It displays campaign notifications or prompts, calls registered app listeners, and records user actions such as accepting or dismissing a prompt.
disableEffect: StreetHawk push campaigns, their app callbacks, and response tracking will stop.
